units.characteristics: refused envy of the wicked; the violence-devising heart seen behind the appeal
units.gist: be not envious of evil men nor desire their company - their hearts devise violence (thread w/ Ps 37:1, 73:3)
by wisdom a house is built and filled; a wise man full of strength, might enhanced, victory in counsel (w/ Ecc 9:16, 21:22)

units.characteristics: sin in the devising; wisdom beyond the fool
units.gist: wisdom too high for a fool; the schemer; the devising of folly is sin, the scoffer an abomination (sin in the planning, w/ Ecc 8:11)
do not lie in wait against the righteous; the evil man has no future, the lamp of the wicked put out (thread w/ Job 18:5)

units.characteristics: the dual reverence (God and king); refusal of rebellion
units.gist: fear the LORD and the king, do not join rebels whose disaster arises suddenly (the fear-of-the-LORD thread)

units.characteristics: impartial judgment; the honest answer as a kiss
units.gist: partiality not good; calling the wicked right is cursed; rebuking the wicked brings delight; an honest answer kisses the lips (w/ 18:5)
I passed the sluggard's field, saw and considered it, looked and received instruction - the reflective self turning observation into teaching (w/ Ecc's watching self)
remove the wicked from the king; do not put yourself forward, better to be told 'come up' than be lowered (w/ Luke 14:8)

units.characteristics: restraint in conflict; keeping a confidence even in a quarrel
units.gist: do not hasten to court; argue with your neighbour directly, do not reveal another's secret, lest lasting shame

units.characteristics: the listening ear that makes reproof golden; faithfulness that refreshes
units.gist: a wise reprover to a listening ear = a gold ring; a faithful messenger refreshes the soul (receptivity thread)

units.characteristics: the empty boaster; trust that fails in the crisis
units.gist: clouds without rain = one who boasts of a gift not given; false witness a war club; trusting a treacherous man = a bad tooth in trouble (w/ Job 6:15)

units.characteristics: restraint of presence, tongue, and self-glory
units.gist: seldom foot in the neighbour's house lest hate; the backbiting tongue -> angry looks; not glorious to seek one's own glory / eat much honey

units.characteristics: the compromised righteous as a fouled spring
units.gist: a righteous man who gives way before the wicked = a muddied spring, a polluted fountain - integrity's failure imaged as a fouled source
better a corner of the housetop than a house with a quarrelsome wife (thread w/ 21:9, 17:1)

units.characteristics: folly as compulsive return; honour absurd on a fool
units.gist: honour unfitting for a fool; giving him honour = binding the stone in the sling; the fool returns to his folly like a dog to vomit - folly as compulsion
answer not a fool (lest you be like him) / answer a fool (lest he be wise in his own eyes) - the same act right or wrong by the moment; the two risks

units.characteristics: meddling as self-injury; the quarrelsome man as strife's fuel
units.gist: meddling in a quarrel not one's own = grabbing a passing dog by the ears; the quarrelsome man kindles strife like charcoal (strife thread)

units.characteristics: deceit masked as joking; flattery as concealed hatred
units.gist: the deceiver who says 'I am only joking!'; the lying tongue hates its victims, the flattering mouth works ruin - malice behind jest and flattery
